picks.editorial_note: Purdue landing two of the first 278 DOE Genesis Mission awards signals a major new federal push to embed AI into large-scale scientific infrastructure, including the Electron-Ion Collider.
picks.title: 2 Purdue AI research projects selected among the first Genesis Mission awards

picks.editorial_note: A £20 million MRC-funded hub led by Cambridge combining stem cell models with AI could meaningfully accelerate and de-risk early drug development, a rare direct bridge from AI research to medicine.
picks.title: Cambridge to lead new £20m MRC Hub to transform development of new medicines using stem cells and AI

picks.editorial_note: EPFL's VirTues foundation model for spatial tumor proteomics represents a genuine advance in applying AI to cancer biology, with direct potential to improve treatment response prediction across many cancer types.
picks.title: AI model maps tumor tissue to improve cancer care

picks.editorial_note: UCLA's use of generative AI to design entirely novel proteins, building on Nobel laureate David Baker's techniques, pushes computational protein engineering into genuinely new territory.
picks.title: UCLA bioengineer Jason Zhang deploys AI to create proteins never before seen in nature

picks.editorial_note: SRI's ARPA-H-funded PARADIGM initiative with Mayo Clinic and University of Florida shows AI moving into frontline clinical guidance, a high-stakes real-world application with strong institutional backing.
picks.title: AI guides healthcare workers through blood draws, intubation, and more - SRI

picks.editorial_note: Haim Sompolinsky's Dirac Medal recognizes foundational statistical-mechanics work underpinning modern neural network theory, a notable honor validating decades of theoretical AI research.
picks.title: The Hebrew University of Jerusalem Congratulates Prof. Haim Sompolinsky on Receiving the 2026 Dirac Medal

picks.editorial_note: UC Riverside's DOE Genesis Mission funding for AI-driven quantum error correction and national-lab data sharing extends the government's strategic bet on AI-accelerated science beyond a single institution.
picks.title: UCR researchers join DOE effort to speed scientific discovery

picks.editorial_note: A $12 million Army Research Laboratory grant to Penn State for animal-inspired AI sensing in autonomous drones and robots marks significant defense investment in next-generation AI hardware.
picks.title: $12M grant to build animal-inspired sensing for autonomous drones and robots | Penn State University

picks.editorial_note: RoboDojo, built with nearly 20 global universities including UC Berkeley and Tsinghua, establishes the first unified benchmark for embodied AI robot reliability, a standard-setting effort with broad field-wide impact.
picks.title: HKU Pioneers "RoboDojo": The First Hong Kong-Led Unified Benchmark for Embodied AI, Setting New Global Standards for Robot Reliability - Press Releases - Media - HKU

picks.editorial_note: University of Alabama's DOE Genesis Mission partnership with Fermilab to apply AI to particle physics data analysis extends AI's reach into fundamental physics research infrastructure.
picks.title: AI meets particle physics in UA-Led Department of Energy project
